carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp luminance gradient with higher pixel values on the dorsal edge transitioning into shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a high-density concentration of small, high-luminance micro-blobs along its dorsal surface, contrasting with the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the primary flank.
